subject: LumOS Supplies — invoice intake preflight (portal vs email) and PO mapping

Subject: Invoice intake — portal vs. email + sample layout

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're well — we're getting LumOS set up in your vendor system and wanted to confirm the preferred invoice intake and a couple of template details before our first billing run. Two quick asks: 

1) Do you require all invoices to be uploaded through the Redwood vendor portal, or can we continue to send invoices to accounts@redwood.inference.com for the next 90 days while we finish integration?

2) Attached is a sample invoice we currently send (lumos-sample-invoice-20271210.pdf). Our invoice places PO number at the top-right and lists line items with unit-level SKU and GL code. Do you have a required field list or a CSV example for PO/stamping/GL mapping?

We'd like to avoid rework on both sides. If the portal is mandatory, can you share the onboarding form or a short checklist we need to complete?

Thanks — Elena

Subject: Re: Invoice intake — portal vs. email + sample layout

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and the sample invoice. Short answers up front: portal preferred, but we can accept email for a limited onboarding window. See details below.

Portal vs email
- Preferred: Redwood Vendor Portal — single source of truth, automatic acknowledgements, better PO matching.
- Temporary fallback: accounts@redwood.inference.com for first 2 invoice cycles (60 days). After that we require portal submissions.

Required invoice fields (minimum)
- Redwood PO number (exact match)
- Invoice number (unique per vendor)
- Invoice date
- Line items: description, quantity, unit price, total
- Supplier tax/VAT id (if applicable)
- Billing contact email

PO stamping and GL mapping
- PO should be present on the invoice (top-right is fine). We prefer a machine-readable PO field ("PO:" or "Purchase Order:") for automated parsing.
- For GL mapping we ask vendors to include a GL column only if your ERP can provide it. If you can't, we will map during AP intake but delays may occur.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (redwood-vendor-onboarding-form-v2.pdf) and a quick CSV example of PO->GL matching (po-matching-examples.csv). Can you confirm whether LumOS can include a separate CSV of line items for large shipments?

Next steps
- If you can use the portal: please start the onboarding form and I will fast-track enabling your account.
- If you need an email fallback: send invoices to accounts@redwood.inference.com and CC me. Please include PO and the invoice CSV if available.

Thanks,
Priyom

--
Priyom Das

Thanks Priyom — a couple of pragmatic notes from ops: 

Elena — quick clarifications to avoid 2-way rework: 
- PO stamping: if you stamp the PO on the PDF AND include a PO field in the invoice file metadata (if generating from your billing system), our parser picks it up 98% of the time. Top-right placement is fine, but avoid embedding it in an image.
- Multiple POs on one invoice: we accept that, but each line item must reference its PO. Use a PO column in CSVs and repeat the PO in the PDF line item table.
- Currency: when invoicing for multiple currencies on one invoice, add a per-line currency column — mixed-currency PDFs trigger manual review and delay.

Operationally, if you send a short CSV with: PO, LineItemID, Qty, UnitPrice, GLCode, we'll auto-apply matching rules. If GLCode is blank, AP will hold for coding.

Cc'ing Monica for GL/ledger questions.

-Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Billing Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake — portal vs. email + sample layout

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for coordinating. A few specific GL/PO rules from finance that will affect timing: 

1) Default holds: invoices missing PO or with mismatched PO amounts > $1,000 will be placed on hold for manual review. Please ensure invoice totals reconcile to PO totals where possible.

2) GL codes: if you can supply a GL column, map to these Redwood labels (examples): 6001-Cloud Infra, 6102-Model Training, 6205-Professional Services. If you cannot provide GLs, please put "TBD" in the column and we'll follow up.

3) Early-pay/discounts: include a separate line with "Early Pay Discount" and a negative amount — do not alter PO unit prices.

4) Portal acknowledgements: invoices submitted via the portal receive a 1-hour automated ack and a matching status. Email submissions get an automated ack in 3 business days.

If LumOS can do the portal in the first cycle, that will significantly reduce hold rates. If not, we will accept email for up to two cycles but please include the CSV for line-level matching.

Elena — can you confirm whether your billing system can export the CSV in the header format Jordan mentioned? If yes, we can provide a small sample mapping file and a one-hour walkthrough.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Finance - Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
